authority.scope: V5.4 learnability recovery, correct-call truth, dual estimands, factorized training, and full-16-action policy evaluation
supersedes: any VALID_APPLICABLE, composite reviewer, or four-axis reviewer projection used as PM gold
preserves: actual Rank-1 frozen before actions and outcomes
ESConv, EvoEmo response, and ES-MemEval complementary external experiments
shared candidate, generator, guard, and evaluator stack across response-policy baselines

triggering_evidence.scientific_conclusion: A language-model judgment that a resource could be useful is not repeatable enough to serve as correct-call truth. Structural validity remains machine-audited; action value must be learned from randomized same-state outcomes.

rank1_and_structural_boundary.rank1_definition: For each component, the exact top-scored structurally legal production candidate, frozen from strictly prior runtime-visible data before any requested action or response outcome.
rank1_is_not: the best candidate chosen after seeing a response
rank1_and_structural_boundary.machine_failure_action: No PM value label is created for that component; report candidate or retrieval OFF separately.
rank1_and_structural_boundary.semantic_reviewer_role: explanation and diagnostic only; never route gold, target, sample deletion rule, or oracle input

outcome_blind_state_contrast_design.variant_unit: one public-source anchor, one unchanged valid actual Rank-1 candidate, and two current-state variants that differ in one predeclared runtime-visible response-need or boundary factor
primary_pair: the same contribution is currently redundant, self-contained, declined, or outside the current response function
outcome_blind_state_contrast_design.construction_assignment_role: A randomized authoring instruction and design-support audit field only. It is never the worth-opening target and is physically excluded from PM features and generator prompts.
fidelity_review_only: both variants remain faithful to the public-source world and owner/time/version
the intended one-axis edit is actually visible in the current text
no component name, route label, construction tag, answer, evidence map, future fact, or outcome is exposed
the response has not already been written
outcome_blind_state_contrast_design.family_binding: anchor, variants, paraphrases, candidate, and template cluster stay in one fold
outcome_blind_state_contrast_design.nuisance_balance: author, length, punctuation, explicitness, topic, subtype, candidate age, session depth, and template family may not alone identify assignment

bounded_semantic_observability_gate.purpose: Show that the frozen deployable representation can distinguish the controlled runtime-visible edit before buying response outcomes; this does not assert human-level understanding.
bounded_semantic_observability_gate.features: the exact frozen PM-visible deterministic fields plus low-dimensional frozen BGE projections; no construction field, outcome, reviewer projection, response, or evaluator gold
bounded_semantic_observability_gate.evaluation: family-held-out prediction of the randomized construction assignment
bounded_semantic_observability_gate.failure_action: Revise only outcome-blind wording or representation in a newly named development revision; spend zero effect API budget and do not blame PM learning.

deployment_itt.definition: The causal effect of requesting an action in the frozen deployed stack, retaining guard decisions, non-use, fallback, and generator behavior exactly as observed.
deployment_itt.role: primary PM training and policy-selection target
deployment_itt.reason: A policy must learn what actually happens after its request, not what an ideal executor might have done.
deployment_itt.risk: absolute and action-attributable material events on every requested arm
deployment_itt.cost: deterministic injected tokens for projection, with realized tokens, latency, USD, fallback, and retries reported separately

clean_execution_mechanism.definition: A descriptive per-protocol view restricted to exact requested-realized match and verified received, used, grounded, and functional resource execution.
clean_execution_mechanism.role: mechanism and responsibility diagnosis only; not substituted for deployment ITT and not treated as randomized after conditioning
reports: candidate semantic contribution when cleanly used
requested to received to used to functional funnel
generator refusal, overload, partial use, and fallback
difference between ITT and clean-use estimates

component_training_target.unit: state by component randomized ON/OFF contrast under a frozen matched background and seed
component_training_target.negative_and_zero_policy: negative effects remain negative; practical ties remain continuous near zero; neither is rewritten from a semantic reviewer label
component_training_target.execution_failure: retained in ITT, separately flagged in the mechanism ledger, and never misreported as clean semantic evidence
component_training_target.model: regularized low-capacity conditional-effect heads over frozen PM-visible features
component_training_target.split: user or dialogue, public-source anchor, counterfactual family, and template cluster bound to the same fold
component_training_target.effective_sample_rule: variants, seeds, judges, arms, and actions do not create independent users; uncertainty is clustered at user/dialogue and family levels

development_learnability_sequence.name: small_deployment_itt_effect_feasibility
development_learnability_sequence.api_permission: requires a separately frozen call manifest and budget after stages 1-2 pass
development_learnability_sequence.design: 12 development families per component, two variants per family, three matched ON/OFF seeds per variant

development_learnability_sequence.name: fresh_formal_factorized_confirmation
development_learnability_sequence.api_permission: only after all development gates pass and all features, model, folds, prompts, seeds, margins, and budgets are frozen
development_learnability_sequence.minimum: 24 fresh counterfactual families per component with two primary variants; at least 12 independent families per formal test fold across repeated grouped cross-fitting

formal_gates.support: nonconstant effects and predictions with both above-margin and at-or-below-margin families

passed: construction assignment physically absent from runtime rows
effect, quality, risk, function, and oracle outcomes absent
all pair word-length ratios at most 2
state_variant_authoring_v1_outcome_20260.required_revision: Keep the exact public-source visible prefix fixed and permit authors to write only two alternative final current-user turns. Do not generate a new assistant prefix. Enforce lexical minimal-pair constraints before any semantic fidelity review.

natural_original_current_turn_reuse.rule: allowed as natural public-source backbone only because rate is at most 0.10 and exact assignment balance prevents source-origin from identifying the construction condition

sixteen_action_policy.architecture: Four learned component scores are projected through hard structural and risk masks to the unchanged 16 legal actions; this is not a 16-class classifier.
sixteen_action_policy.training_efficiency: Factorized matched ON/OFF contrasts train component effects; a full 16-action sweep is not falsely counted as 16 independent training examples.
sixteen_action_policy.interaction_rule: Only development-supported, predeclared low-order interaction corrections may be added; otherwise interactions are reported as model limitation.
sixteen_action_policy.joint_panel: After at least one learned head qualifies, freeze 32 outcome-blind common natural public-backbone states and execute all 16 actions under the same candidate set, generator, guard, seed schedule, and evaluators.
requested_action_itt_oracle_set: use every structurally valid requested action even when realized use or fallback differs, provided ITT Q and R are measured
exclude structurally invalid and resolved material or critical-risk actions
retain all safe actions within the frozen 0.10 Q equivalence margin
among that frontier retain the exact minimum deterministic injected-token cost actions, preserving exact ties
primary_metrics: excess deterministic cost on the quality frontier
unsafe or structurally invalid selection rate
beneficial false-OFF and harmful false-ON on resolved component contrasts

responsibility_rules.catalog_adapter: valid strictly-prior information was not materialized or lineage is wrong
responsibility_rules.retriever: a valid candidate existed but production Rank-1 selected the wrong, stale, redundant, or wrong-owner item
responsibility_rules.representation_scope: the controlled semantic distinction is absent from the frozen PM-visible representation; report abstention or fail-closed coverage
responsibility_rules.pm: after valid Rank-1, observable state support, measured ITT labels, and qualified training, the cross-fitted policy selects outside the resolved component-compatible or joint oracle set
responsibility_rules.step2_generator: the PM request is oracle-compatible but requested-realized, received, used, functional, grounding, or fallback requirements fail
responsibility_rules.resource_generator_interaction: cleanly executed evidence still lowers Q or causes attributable risk
responsibility_rules.measurement: Q or R outcome, judge resolution, or transport remains unresolved
responsibility_rules.deployment_view: policy ITT is charged with all downstream outcomes regardless of mechanism owner
responsibility_rules.mechanism_view: the earliest supported causal failure layer is separately reported

external_experiments: ESConv response for RS and memory hard-OFF
EvoEmo longitudinal response for MP/MS/ME/RS cross-fitted routing
ES-MemEval QA for extraction, temporal, conflict, user modeling, and abstention
baselines_and_external.shared_stack_rule: All response-policy baselines share candidate pool, retriever, actual Rank-1, typed injection, generator absorption, guard, and evaluator; no post-generation concatenation is permitted.
baselines_and_external.external_authorization: blocked until at least one head passes fresh formal confirmation and a deployable 16-action policy is frozen

guaranteed_by_process: the PM is not trained on subjective should-open reviewer gold
the representation must first demonstrate bounded observability
actual randomized outcomes must first demonstrate condition-dependent effect separation
the low-capacity head must pass family-held-out development before formal confirmation
failed heads remain OFF and transparent rules remain separate baselines
all final correct-call claims come from held-out outcomes and an unchanged 16-action oracle definition
what_can_and_cannot_be_guaranteed.not_guaranteed: A favorable scientific result or universal language understanding. If any staged gate fails, the component is honestly unsupported rather than repaired after seeing formal or external outcomes.
